This Freelance Services Contract (“Agreement”) is entered into on [Date] by and between:

Freelancer:

The Freelancer agrees to provide the following services (“Services”):

[Describe the project scope, deliverables, platforms, consulting services, or freelance work]

- Design files
- Written content
- Website development
- Branding materials
- Marketing assets
- Consulting deliverables
- Technical services
- Other agreed work product

2. SCOPE OF WORK
The Services include only the work specifically described in this Agreement.

The following are considered outside the original scope unless otherwise agreed in writing:

- Additional revisions beyond included rounds
- New deliverables or features
- Additional meetings or consulting hours
- Rush delivery requests
- Expanded project requirements

Out-of-scope work shall be billed at:
[$Amount] per hour or [Flat Fee Terms]

3. PROJECT TIMELINE
Project Start Date: [Start Date]
Estimated Completion Date: [Completion Date]

Milestones:

- Milestone 1: [Description and Date]
- Milestone 2: [Description and Date]
- Milestone 3: [Description and Date]

The Client agrees to provide approvals, feedback, content, and required materials promptly.

Any delays caused by missing feedback, incomplete materials, or delayed approvals may extend project deadlines accordingly.

4. PAYMENT TERMS
Total Project Fee: [$Amount]

Payment Structure:

- Deposit Due Before Work Begins: [Percentage or Amount]
- Milestone Payments: [Describe schedule]
- Final Payment Due: [Describe final payment terms]

Invoices are due within:
[Net 15 / Net 30 / Number of Days]

Late payments may result in:

- Late fees of [Percentage or Amount]
- Suspension of work
- Delayed delivery of final files or services

The Freelancer may withhold final deliverables, transferable files, launch access, or ownership rights until payment is received in full.

5. REVISIONS AND CHANGES
Included revisions:
[Number] rounds of revisions.

Additional revisions or project changes beyond the agreed scope shall be billed separately.

The Freelancer will notify the Client before performing additional billable work.

6. CLIENT RESPONSIBILITIES
The Client agrees to:

- Provide accurate information and materials
- Respond to requests and approvals in a timely manner
- Obtain permissions for supplied content or assets
- Review deliverables promptly
- Maintain communication regarding project requirements

7. INTELLECTUAL PROPERTY AND OWNERSHIP
Unless otherwise agreed in writing:

- The Freelancer retains ownership of preliminary concepts, drafts, rejected materials, templates, working files, processes, and tools
- The Client receives rights only to the final approved deliverables after full payment is received
- The Freelancer retains the right to display completed work in portfolios, websites, presentations, social media, and marketing materials unless otherwise agreed

Ownership or licensing terms:
[Describe copyright transfer, licensing rights, exclusivity, or source file ownership]

8. CONFIDENTIALITY
Both parties agree to maintain the confidentiality of private business information, trade secrets, login credentials, financial information, and unpublished project materials.

9. THIRD-PARTY MATERIALS
The Client is responsible for securing appropriate rights or licenses for any third-party materials supplied for the Project.

Third-party materials may include:

- Stock photos
- Fonts
- Music
- Video clips
- Software
- Brand assets
- Licensed content

10. TERMINATION AND KILL FEE
Either party may terminate this Agreement with written notice.

If the Client cancels the Project after work has started:

- The initial deposit shall remain non-refundable
- The Client shall pay for all work completed through the cancellation date
- A kill fee of [$Amount or Percentage] may apply for reserved project time and disruption of workflow

Upon termination, the Freelancer retains ownership of unfinished or unpaid work.

11. LIMITATION OF LIABILITY
The Freelancer shall not be responsible for indirect damages, lost profits, business interruption, or third-party claims arising from the use of the deliverables.

12. INDEPENDENT CONTRACTOR STATUS
The Freelancer is acting as an independent contractor and not as an employee, partner, or legal representative of the Client.

13. GOVERNING LAW
This Agreement shall be governed by the laws of:
[State/Country]

14. ENTIRE AGREEMENT
This Agreement represents the complete understanding between the parties regarding the Services.

15. SIGNATURES
By signing below, both parties acknowledge and agree to the terms of this Agreement.

Printed Name: _________________________________
Date: ________________________________________

Client Signature: ______________________________
Printed Name: _________________________________
Date: ________________________________________

faqs.question: What is a freelance services contract?
faqs.answer: A freelance services contract is an agreement outlining project scope, payment terms, timelines, revisions, and ownership rights between a freelancer and client.

faqs.question: Why should freelancers require a deposit?
faqs.answer: Deposits help secure the project, reserve time, and reduce the risk of non-payment.

faqs.question: What is a kill fee?
faqs.answer: A kill fee compensates the freelancer if the client cancels the project after work has already begun.

faqs.question: Who owns the final work product?
faqs.answer: Ownership depends on the agreement terms, but many freelancers transfer rights only after full payment is received.

faqs.question: Why are revision limits important?

faqs.question: What is a freelance scope of work agreement?

intro: A freelance revision policy establishes clear expectations around edits, approvals, feedback timelines, and additional work requests during a freelance project. A strong revision policy helps freelancers prevent endless change requests, reduce scope creep, maintain healthy client relationships, and protect project profitability while still delivering a professional client experience.
whenToUse: Use this revision policy template for freelance design, writing, branding, development, marketing, consulting, video production, social media, creative, and client service projects where revisions, approvals, and feedback management are required.

Effective Date: [Date]

1. PURPOSE
This Revision Policy outlines the process, limitations, timelines, and fees related to project revisions and client feedback for services provided by [Freelancer Name or Business Name]. The purpose of this policy is to maintain clear communication, protect project timelines, and ensure efficient collaboration between all parties.

2. INCLUDED REVISION ROUNDS
Unless otherwise specified in writing, all projects include:

- [Number] rounds of revisions per deliverable
- Minor edits directly related to the approved project brief
- Reasonable refinements to improve the final deliverable

Each revision round consists of one consolidated list of requested changes submitted by the Client.

3. DEFINITION OF A REVISION
A revision refers to minor modifications made to existing approved concepts, drafts, or deliverables.

Examples of included revisions may include:
- Text edits
- Minor color adjustments
- Layout refinements
- Small formatting changes
- Minor repositioning of design elements
- Clarifications or copy corrections

The following are NOT considered revisions and may require a separate agreement or additional fees:
- Complete redesigns
- New concepts after approval
- Major structural or strategic changes
- Requests outside the original project brief
- Additional deliverables
- Platform or format expansions
- Rewriting or recreating approved work from scratch

4. FEEDBACK SUBMISSION WINDOW
The Client agrees to review submitted deliverables and provide consolidated feedback within [Number] business days of delivery.

If no feedback is received within this timeframe:
- The deliverable may be considered approved
- The project timeline may shift accordingly
- The project may be archived or closed after [Number] days of inactivity

Reactivation of dormant projects may require additional scheduling fees.

5. CONSOLIDATED FEEDBACK REQUIREMENT
To maintain workflow efficiency, all revision requests must be submitted in:
- One email
- One shared document
- One project management thread
- One organized communication format

Feedback submitted in fragmented messages across multiple channels may:
- Delay the project timeline
- Count as additional revision rounds
- Result in additional administrative fees

New requests submitted after revisions have already been implemented may be treated as a separate revision round.

6. ADDITIONAL REVISION FEES
Any revisions beyond the included revision rounds will be billed at one of the following rates:

- [$Amount] per additional revision round
- [$Amount] per hour
- Custom quote depending on scope

The Freelancer reserves the right to pause work on additional revisions until payment for extra work is received.

7. SCOPE CHANGES AND CHANGE ORDERS
Any revision request that substantially changes the original project scope may require:
- A revised estimate
- A formal change order
- Additional timeline adjustments
- A separate project agreement

Examples of scope changes include:
- New branding direction
- Additional pages or deliverables
- New feature requests
- Replacing previously approved concepts
- New campaign objectives

All scope changes must be approved in writing before work begins.

8. PROJECT TIMELINE IMPACT
Revision requests may affect project timelines.

Delays caused by:
- Late feedback
- Incomplete instructions
- Additional revisions
- Scope changes
- Delayed approvals

May automatically extend final delivery dates.

The Freelancer is not responsible for missed deadlines resulting from delayed client communication.

9. CLIENT APPROVAL PROCESS
At the conclusion of the revision process, the Client agrees to provide written approval confirming that:
- The deliverables meet expectations
- Requested revisions are complete
- The project is approved for final delivery

Acceptable forms of approval include:
- Email confirmation
- Signed approval document
- Approval inside a project platform

Upon approval:
- Final invoices may be issued
- Final files may be delivered
- Additional edits may be billed separately

10. FINAL FILE DELIVERY
Final deliverables will be released after:
- Final approval is received
- Outstanding invoices are paid in full
- Any agreed-upon licensing or transfer terms are completed

Editable source files, raw files, or working documents are not included unless specifically stated in writing.

11. RUSH REVISIONS
Revision requests requiring expedited turnaround times outside standard business scheduling may incur rush fees.

Rush availability is not guaranteed.

12. COMMUNICATION EXPECTATIONS
The Client agrees to:
- Provide clear and organized feedback
- Designate a primary decision-maker when applicable
- Avoid conflicting instructions from multiple stakeholders
- Respond professionally and within agreed timelines

The Freelancer agrees to:
- Review revision requests professionally
- Communicate timeline updates
- Clarify unclear feedback before implementation when necessary

13. PROJECT CLOSURE
Projects may be formally closed if:
- The revision limit has been reached
- The Client has approved deliverables
- No communication has been received for [Number] days
- Outstanding invoices remain unpaid

Reopening closed projects may require:
- New scheduling availability
- Additional fees
- A separate agreement

14. LIMITATION OF REVISIONS
The Freelancer reserves the right to refuse revision requests that:
- Contradict prior approvals
- Fall outside the original agreement
- Create unreasonable project delays
- Conflict with professional standards
- Violate legal or ethical guidelines

15. ACCEPTANCE OF POLICY
By engaging the Freelancer's services, the Client acknowledges that they have read, understood, and agreed to this Revision Policy.
